item.title: Report: Stags 0-0 Exeter
item.description: Mansfield Town stretched their impressive unbeaten run to nine matches this afternoon with a goalless draw at One Call Stadium against Exeter City. Both sides were resolute defensively in a game which lacked clear goalscoring opportunities, resulting in Stags collecting a hard-fought point. Manager Nigel Clough made four changes from the side that played out a stalemate with Wycombe Wanderers at One Call Stadium last Saturday. item.title: Youth report: Stags U18 3-3 Chesterfield U18
item.description: A last-gasp equaliser from substitute Josh Nicholls helped Mansfield Town under-18s rescue a valuable point following a 3-3 draw with rivals Chesterfield in the Youth Alliance League on Saturday. The young Stags took the lead at RH Academy via midfielder TJ Grimes but found themselves behind at the interval after striker Ben Hole and midfielder Louie Ward netted for the away side. item.title: Report: Stags 1-2 Peterborough
item.description: Mansfield Town’s nine-match unbeaten run came to an end this evening as Peterborough United left One Call Stadium with a narrow 2-1 victory. Stags had the better of the chances throughout the match, but fell behind nine minutes into the second-half when midfielder Jimmy-Jay Morgan swept home the opening goal in Nottinghamshire.
